app.welcome: Welcome to Bereket Plastic Factory Management System
app.tagline: Sales, production, service, quality and warehouse — one source of truth.

common.readOnly: View only — you don't have permission to change this.
common.notAvailableYet: This module is being built in a later stage.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.deleteConfirm: Delete {name} permanently? This only works if it has never been used.
common.connectionRetry: The connection was interrupted, so we don't know if this was saved. Press Save again — it will not be saved twice.

auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Account locked for 15 minutes.
auth.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the administrator.
auth.help: Forgot your password? Ask the administrator to reset it.
auth.changePasswordIntro: Please set a new password before continuing.
auth.rules: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.forbiddenBody: Your role doesn't include permission for this page. Ask the administrator if you need it.

admin.temporaryPasswordHelp: Give this to the employee privately. It is shown only once and must be changed at first sign-in.
admin.disableConfirm: Disable this account? The employee is signed out immediately.
admin.cannotDisableSelf: You can't disable your own account.
admin.cannotRemoveOwnAdmin: You can't remove administration rights from your own role.

install.title: Add Bereket FMS to your home screen
install.ios: Tap Share ⎙ then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.other: Open it in one tap, like an app.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Bereket FMS needs a connection to show live factory data. Reconnect and try again.

md.cycleTimeHint: Used to check if a planned job fits its time slot
md.qcRequiredHint: Otherwise batches are released and QC checks randomly
md.moldOfProductHint: The mold this product is made on. Every label on the same mold is its own product.
md.productNameHint: For labelled products: the label name, e.g. “Zakho Water 500 ml”.
md.showingFirst: Showing the first {n} of {total}. Choose a mold or search to see the rest.
md.pasteLabelsHint: Type or paste the label names, one per line (you can copy a whole column from Excel). Codes are given automatically ({code}-001, -002…). To use your own codes, paste two columns: code and name.
md.sameForAll: Optional — applied to every label in this list:
md.labelsSkipped: {n} were already there and were skipped.
md.label: Label
md.labelHint: The label used on this product (1 per piece). The product's name is typed by hand.
md.productNameFromLabel: Only for products without a label. With a label, the name is taken from the label.
md.notUsedYet: Not used by any product yet.
md.unitWeightHint: Needed when products count this item by the bag (e.g. 30 nylon per carton) but it is stocked in kg.

order.changeReasonHint: Required when dates change on a confirmed order
order.needMasterData: Add at least one customer and one product first.
order.newHint: Type the amount next to each product you need. Leave the rest empty.
order.deletedMsg: Order deleted. The audit log keeps a record of who deleted it and why.
order.addManyTitle: Tick the products to add — then type each quantity
order.filterProducts: Filter products by code or name…
order.needProducts: Add products first — orders and daily production are typed against the product list.
order.stockNote: “In stock” is today's warehouse stock for each product.

act.completeHelp: Use when everything on this order has been delivered.
act.cancelHelp: The order stays in the list as cancelled and no longer counts as demand.
act.reopenHelp: Makes the order open again so it can be edited and counts as demand.
act.deleteHelp: Only for orders entered by mistake. The order disappears completely; a record of who deleted it and why stays in the audit log.

qc.hold: QC put the batch on hold

sched.acknowledge: I understand the warnings — schedule anyway
sched.rescheduleReasonHint: Required if time, machine or mold changes
sched.allPlanned: All open orders are fully planned.

conflict.MACHINE_OVERLAP: {machine} is already booked for {job} at this time.
conflict.MOLD_OVERLAP: Mold {mold} is planned on {machine} for {job} at this time.
conflict.MOLD_PRODUCT_MISMATCH: Mold {mold} is registered for a different product than {product}.
conflict.DEADLINE: Finishes after the requested delivery date of {order}.
conflict.CAPACITY: Needs about {needed} h at this cycle time, but the slot is {available} h.
conflict.OVER_PLANNED: Planned total {planned} pcs is more than the {ordered} ordered.

prod.logDowntimeHint: For a stop that already ended, without pausing the job.
prod.createMaintenance: Send a maintenance request to Technical Service
prod.breakdownHint: A breakdown always creates a maintenance request.
prod.completeHint: Closes the open batch and frees the machine. Remaining quantity stays on the order for a new job.
prod.correctHint: Old entries are never changed. A correction adds a + or − line with your reason, so the history stays complete.
prod.deltaHint: Use a minus sign to remove, e.g. -200
prod.noBatches: A batch opens when the job starts.
prod.searchPlaceholder: Job, order, product code or batch…
prod.nothingDay: Nothing entered for this day yet.
prod.correctHelp: Stock changes by the difference. Enter 0 to delete the entry. Entries already inspected by QC can't be changed.

svc.pmTitleHint: e.g. Change hydraulic oil filter, Clean mold vents
svc.newRequestHint: Technical Service is notified straight away.
svc.problemHint: Short and clear, e.g. 'Oil leak at clamp cylinder'
svc.machineDownHint: The machine is shown as down in the schedule until the repair is completed.
svc.newReportHint: Record mold changes, repairs and maintenance done on your shift.
svc.moldChangeReasonHint: Required when a mold is removed or installed
svc.downtimeHint: Leave empty to use start → end

done.complete: Repair completed — Production has been notified.

hist.repeatedWarning: Repeated failures: {n} breakdowns in the last {days} days. Consider a root-cause check or overhaul.

qc.policy: QC picks daily production entries at random. Products marked “QC required” are listed first. Rejected pieces are removed from stock automatically.
qc.categoriesHelp: Defect types used in inspections. Disable a type instead of deleting it, so past records stay intact.
qc.producedInBatch: {n} good pieces produced in this batch
qc.holdOnlyHint: You can put a batch on hold. Releasing or rejecting needs QC approval rights.
qc.actionPlaceholder: What was done to fix the cause?

effect.APPROVE: The whole batch becomes approved stock.
effect.PARTIAL: Sorting result: the rejected and held pieces are blocked, the rest is released.
effect.HOLD: The whole batch is blocked (quarantine) until QC decides. It can't be shipped.
effect.REJECT: The whole batch is rejected and can never be shipped.

qc.addNewDefect: + It's a different defect — record it
qc.effectReject: {n} pcs will be removed from stock and the entry marked Rejected.
qc.effectApprove: No defects: the entry will be marked Approved.

wh.ledgerNote: Products go up from daily production; stickers and materials go up when received. Everything goes down when used, taken out or rejected. Totals can't be typed in.
wh.adjustHint: For counts, damage or scrapping rejected goods. Every adjustment is logged with your name and reason.
wh.receivedQuarantine: {number} saved — {n} pcs went to quarantine because of the batch's QC status.
wh.overReason: Why is the count higher than production reported?
wh.overHint: Production reported {n} pcs still to receive.
wh.overBlocked: Only {n} pcs are waiting. A supervisor must approve a higher count.
wh.referenceHint: e.g. order number, truck or person
wh.adjustQtyHint: Positive adds pieces, negative removes them (e.g. −20).
wh.moreInReport: Showing the latest 300. Use the Stock movements report for older ones.
wh.noStickers: No labels yet. Add them with New item or Import from Excel.
wh.noMaterials: No raw materials yet. Add them with New item or Import from Excel.
wh.noPackaging: No packaging items yet. Add them with New item or Import from Excel.
wh.readOnlyNote: Stock on hand. It changes only through Stock Movements (input, output, buy, sell) and daily production.

rep.intro: Live figures from the factory's records. Pick a report, set the dates and filters, then export to Excel (CSV) or PDF.
rep.noExport: You can view reports. Exporting to CSV or PDF needs the "Reports: export" permission.
rep.pdfHint: Choose "Save as PDF" as the printer to get a PDF file.
rep.noData: No records match these dates and filters.
rep.rowsLimited: Showing the first {n} of {total} rows — export to see them all.
rep.chartTop: Top {n} of {total} shown — all are in the table.

production.title: Production output
production.desc: Pieces produced and rejected by day, week, month, product or shift.

maintenance.title: Maintenance requests
maintenance.desc: Requests raised, their status and how long repairs took.

mold-changes.title: Mold changes
mold-changes.desc: Every mold removed or installed, with time taken and technician.

quality.title: Rejection rates
quality.desc: Inspections, rejected pieces and rejection rates by product.

defects.title: Quality defects
defects.desc: Quality issues by defect type and severity.

corrective.title: Corrective actions
corrective.desc: Every corrective action recorded against a quality issue.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.desc: Every stock change: produced, QC rejected, out and adjustments.

production-entries.title: Daily production entries
production-entries.desc: Every entry with day, shift, quantity and QC result.

orders.title: Orders
orders.desc: Orders with their status, products and pieces.

demand.title: Ordered vs. stock
demand.desc: For each product in open orders: pieces ordered, in stock and still to make.

stock.title: Stock by product
stock.desc: Pieces in, out and in stock for each product.

trade.title: Buying and selling
trade.desc: Every bought and sold item with supplier/customer, price and total in IQD, USD or EUR.

cash.title: Safe: money in and out
cash.desc: Every movement of money with category, person and totals per currency.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Find any order, product, label, material, machine, mold, quality issue, maintenance request or stock movement.
search.typeMore: Type at least 2 characters. Typing an exact number (like ORD-2026-0001) opens that record directly.

ui.errorBody: Nothing was lost. Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, tell the administrator the reference below.
ui.notFoundBody: The record may have been moved, or the link is wrong. Try searching for it.

audit.intro: Who did what and when. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

sys.resetTitle: Clear test data before going live
sys.resetIntro: Use this once, when testing is finished and the factory starts using the system for real. It permanently deletes these records:
sys.keptList: employees and their logins, roles and permissions, departments, defect types and the audit log. Numbering starts again from 0001.
sys.scopeOpsHint: Orders, daily production, maintenance, QC and stock. Products, machines and molds stay.
sys.scopeAllHint: Also deletes {products} products, {machines} machines and {molds} molds.
sys.warning: This cannot be undone. Make sure a backup exists first (see the backup guide).
sys.resetDone: Done. The system is clean and ready for real use. This reset is recorded in the audit log.
sys.demoIntro: {n} demo accounts (usernames starting with demo.) exist. Remove them before going live.
sys.itemsIntro: Removes every product, sticker and material so a corrected Excel list can be imported in their place. Machines, molds, employees and the audit log stay.
sys.itemsWarning: This can't be undone. Keep the Excel file so you can import it again.
sys.itemsDone: {n} items removed. Now import the new list:
sys.itemsUsed: {n} items are already used by orders, production or stock, so the list can't be removed. Clear the test transactions first (above).

daily.title: Daily production entry
daily.subtitle: {date} · type what was produced for each product and save once.
daily.saved: Saved {n} products, {pcs} pieces. Stock was updated.
daily.noOrdered: No product is in an open order. Untick the box to see all products.
daily.shortage: Saved — but stock was not enough for: {items}. Stock shows minus; the warehouse has been told.

imp.title: Import from Excel
imp.subtitle: Add or update many machines, molds and products (labels) at once.
imp.step1Hint: An Excel file with three sheets: Machines, Molds and Products. Fill it in, or paste your existing lists into it.
imp.tip1: One row per label on the Products sheet, with the mold code.
imp.tip2: Product code can stay empty — it is created automatically from the mold code.
imp.tip3: Importing the same file again updates rows instead of making copies.
imp.tip4: Nothing is saved until every row is correct.
imp.choose: Choose the Excel or CSV file
imp.hasErrors: {n} problems found. Fix them in Excel and check the file again — nothing was saved.
imp.nothing: Nothing new to import — everything in the file is already in the system.

push.askBody: New orders, production, QC results, stock and breakdowns will pop up even when the app is closed.
push.explain: Pop-up notifications, also when the app or browser is closed.
push.devicesN: Turned on for you on {n} device(s).
push.testSent: Test sent — it should pop up in a few seconds.
push.nowOn: Done — this device will now get notifications.
push.dismissed: The browser's question was closed without an answer. Press the button again and choose Allow.
push.failed: Couldn't turn notifications on. Try again.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Open the browser's site settings (the lock icon next to the address), set Notifications to Allow, then reload. On Android you can also check Settings → Apps → Chrome → Notifications.
push.iosInstall: On iPhone, notifications work only from the installed app: tap Share → Add to Home Screen, open Bereket FMS from the home screen, then turn notifications on here.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive push notifications. Use Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari (installed app on iPhone).
push.notConfigured: Push notifications aren't set up on the server yet.

shortage.title: Not enough stock for production: {n} items

rc.label: Label
rc.labelHint: The product's label: 1 label per piece is taken from stock when production is entered. Choosing it doesn't change the product's name.
rc.madeOfHint: Raw materials and colours in grams per piece; handles and other parts in pieces per piece.
rc.packagingHint: For each carton or nylon: how many products go into one. Started cartons and bags count as used. Nylon kept in kg is turned into kg with its bag weight.
rc.needWeight: Set the weight of one bag first
rc.saved: Saved. From now on daily production takes these from stock.
rc.nothingUsed: Nothing is taken from stock yet — add a label, materials or packaging.
rc.previewNote: Unsaved changes are included in the preview.
rc.nameNoLabel: Only when the product has no label.
rc.newIntro: Pick the label first — the name comes from it. Then add what one piece is made of and how it is packed.
rc.created: Product created. Daily production will now take its label, materials and packaging from stock.
rc.nameTyped: Type the product's own name. It never comes from the label (a label's name has "اتيكيت" in it).

sd.intro: Every manual change of stock: input, output, buy and sell. Production and what it uses still change stock automatically.
sd.fillFromOrder: Fill the lines from this order
sd.fillHint: The list button fills the lines with the order's products.
sd.minusNow: Below zero now: {items}. Check the count.
sd.noSales: Nothing sold for this order yet.

help.INPUT: Items coming in without money: returns, transfers, count corrections.
help.OUTPUT: Items going out without money: damage, samples, transfers, count corrections.
help.BUY: Items bought from a customer account, with the price in IQD, USD or EUR. A discount only lowers what is owed to them.
help.SELL: Items sold to a customer, with the price in IQD, USD or EUR. Link it to an order if there is one.

sd.invoiceAuto: The invoice number is given automatically.
sd.purchaseAuto: Our purchase number (PUR-…) is given automatically.
sd.buyRateHint: Typed by you. The customer's balance is in {cur}; the IQD value is for the records.
sd.editing: You are changing {number}. It keeps its number; stock, the customer's balance and batches follow the new values.
sd.editPaidHint: Money already paid stays as it is; change a payment on its own page.

cash.intro: Money in each safe, per currency. Sales and money put in add to a safe; purchases and expenses take from it.
cash.saved: {number} saved. The safe has been updated.
cash.paidHint: Taken from the safe. Starts at 0 — type what was really paid, or press Paid in full.
cash.receivedHint: Goes into the safe. Starts at 0 — type what was really received, or press Paid in full.
cash.convertHint: Only a calculation at the rates you type — the money in the safe is not changed. To really change money use Exchange.

help.IN: Money put into the safe by hand (not from a sale), e.g. from the owner or a bank.
help.OUT: An expense paid from the safe: salaries, electricity, fuel… You can't take out more than the safe holds.
help.EXCHANGE: Change money from one currency into another. Type any two of the three boxes — amount you give, rate, amount you receive — and the third is calculated. The money can go into another safe.
help.TRANSFER: Move money of one currency from one safe to another. The total doesn't change.

rc2.intro: Saved layouts for printing sales, purchases and payment receipts. Print from a sale or purchase with the Print receipt button.
rc2.none: No layouts yet. Receipts print in the standard layout.
rc2.noneManage: No layouts yet. Press New layout to make the first one.
rc2.howToPrint: To print: open a sale or purchase (Stock Movements) and press Print receipt, then choose the layout and press Print.
rc2.name: Layout name
rc2.default: Use this layout first for this kind of receipt
rc2.bannerHint: Upload the banner picture (PNG or JPG) exactly as it should appear across the top of the receipt.
rc2.bannerTooBig: The picture is too large. Use one under 1 MB.
rc2.bannerBad: This file isn't a picture the browser can read.
rc2.showLogo: Show the Bereket logo when there is no banner
rc2.title: Title
rc2.titleHint: Empty = Sales invoice / Purchase invoice / Payment receipt
rc2.columnsHint: Tick the columns to print and use the arrows to change their order.

cust.intro: Customer accounts — the factory sells to them and buys from them. A sale or money paid to them lowers the balance; a purchase from them or money received raises it. − = they owe the factory, + = the factory owes them.
cust.name: Customer name
cust.signHint: − = the customer owes the factory · + = the factory owes them
cust.receiveHint: Money from this customer goes into the safe and raises the balance. More than owed is allowed — the factory then owes the customer (+).
cust.received: {number} saved. The money is in the safe.
cust.payHint: Money paid to this customer (e.g. for what was bought from them) leaves the chosen safe and lowers the balance.
cust.paid: {number} saved. The money left the safe.

safe.calculated: Calculated from the other two boxes — type here to change it
safe.name: Safe name
safe.manageHint: Each safe has its own name and the currencies it holds. A currency can be removed only when that safe has none of it; a safe can be deleted only if it was never used.

item.newTitle: New label, raw material or packaging
item.intro: Choose what it is, type its name and how it is counted, and its cost.
item.name: Name
item.codeHint: Leave empty for an automatic code.
item.bagWeightHint: For packaging bought by kg but used by the piece (e.g. nylon bags).
item.created: {code} saved. It is now in the warehouse and can be used in products, buying and stock movements.
item.unitLocked: Stock already moved in or out, so the unit can't change.

cost.title: Starting cost
cost.hint: Price of one unit, in the currency you paid. For USD or EUR also type today's rate. It is the cost of the stock that was here before batches started, and of stock taken when no batch is left. Every purchase makes its own batch at its own price and rate.
cost.productHint: For the number of pieces made: the same amounts production takes from stock — full cartons and bags (a started one counts), nylon by its kg — costed from the oldest batches still in stock (then at the latest cost), in IQD.
cost.missing: No cost yet for: {items} — the total doesn't include them.
cost.noRecipe: Nothing is set yet for what this product is made of and packed in, so its cost can't be worked out.
cost.partial: Some items have no cost yet
cost.tableHint: Cost per unit = the batches still in stock (each at its own cost) ÷ the stock. With no stock: the latest cost. * = some of it has no cost yet.
cost.valueHint: In IQD: what is in stock × its cost. {n} items in stock.
cost.valueNoCost: {n} of them have no cost yet and are not counted

iw.title: Items workbook
iw.subtitle: All labels, raw materials, packaging and products in one Excel file: fill in what is missing, upload it back.
iw.step1Hint: It already lists every item in the system with what is known about it, its stock now and its cost.
iw.tip1: Sheets: Labels, Raw materials, Packaging, Products, Made of & packaging. Add new items in new rows; leave Code empty for an automatic code.
iw.tip2: Rows are matched on their code. Empty cells never delete anything; grey columns are not read.
iw.tip3: Cost: price of 1 piece or 1 kg + currency; for USD / EUR also today's rate to IQD.
iw.tipNoCost: Costs are left out: your role doesn't see money.
iw.tip4: Counted stock: what is on the shelf now. The stock is set to it with one Input / Output count document. Empty = stock unchanged.
iw.tip5: Check file shows what will change and any mistakes by row before anything is saved.
iw.stock: Stock count: {up} items go up, {down} go down
iw.fromImport: To fill in labels, raw materials, packaging, costs and stock for items already in the system, use the

lot.title: Batches (oldest used first)
lot.hint: Each purchase, production run or priced input is a batch with its own cost in IQD (price × that day's rate). Production, sales and every other way out take from the oldest batch first.
lot.runCost: Real cost: {piece} IQD / pc · run {run} IQD
lot.inputHint: Type a cost per line to make it a batch at that cost; empty lines use the item's starting cost.
